description: Edit this sheet of eight small chibi pixel art figures: the top row walks towards the viewer, the bottom row walks away from the viewer. Dress every figure in the same outfit and change nothing else: keep each figure's pose, size, place, bald head, ears and face exactly as they are, with the same chunky pixel size, the same thick dark outline and the same flat shading with a few tones per colour. The outfit: a zip-up track jacket in royal blue with two white stripes down each sleeve, matching blue track trousers with white side stripes, and white sneakers. Seen from behind: the back of the royal-blue track jacket with white sleeve stripes, blue track trousers and white sneakers. Simple bold shapes, no fine pattern. The hands stay bare. Transparent background, nothing else added.
